notes.claim: A balanced object has total clockwise moment about a pivot equal to total anticlockwise moment about that pivot.
A moment of a force is the force multiplied by the distance, measured at right angles to the direction of the force.
The distance in a moment is measured from the pivot, at a right angle to the line of action of the force.

sources.title: Moments and balanced objects - Moments, levers and gears - AQA - GCSE Physics (Single Science) Revision - AQA - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: If an object is balanced, the total clockwise moment about a pivot is equal to the total anticlockwise moment about that pivot.

sources.title: GCSE SCIENCE Physics equations and maths skills Booklet 1
sources.quote: moment of a force = force × distance normal to direction of force

sources.title: Moments - Forces and movement - KS3 Physics - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: It is very important to remember that the distance from the pivot is measured at a right angle, or perpendicular , to the line of action of the force.
